def featvec(D, mark, gr, gc, hr, wc):
    marks=[(r,c) for r in range(D.shape[0]) for c in range(D.shape[1]) if D[r,c]==mark]
    rows=[]
    for ri,r0 in enumerate(gr):
        for ci,c0 in enumerate(gc):
            blk=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in marks if r0<=r<r0+hr and c0<=c<c0+wc]
            n=len(blk)
            colpairs_adj=0; colpairs_gap=0; rowpairs_adj=0
            for cc in set(c for r,c in blk):
                rs=sorted(r for r,c in blk if c==cc)
                for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
                    if b-a==1: colpairs_adj+=1
                    elif b-a>=2: colpairs_gap+=1
            rr=sorted(set(r for r,c in blk))
            for a,b in zip(rr,rr[1:]):
                if b-a==1: rowpairs_adj+=1
            rows.append((n,colpairs_adj,colpairs_gap,rowpairs_adj))
    return rows
